statement: systemd 60-input-id.rules calls input_id; builtin input_id determines ID_INPUT_JOYSTICK by evdev capabilities with joystick/keyboard heuristics; 70-uaccess grants TAG+=uaccess to input devices with ID_INPUT_JOYSTICK. This does not grant blanket hidraw device access.
